---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a calibrator, metric or API improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem would this solve?**
The use case or limitation you are hitting.

**Proposed solution**
What you would like Fiducio to do. For a new calibrator, a reference to the
method (paper / equation) is very helpful.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you currently use.

**Additional context**
2D vs 3D, binary vs multiclass, logits vs probabilities, scale of data.
